fusions.name: Chorus Croak
fusions.desc: Croaks in a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 11 damage to everything in it and stunning it for 0.8 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Herd Signal
fusions.desc: Spits a clot of warm mud at the first enemy it meets, dealing 26 damage. If it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Barn Warmth
fusions.desc: Restores 15 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Chewing the Cud
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14. It also regenerates 1 health a second, permanently.
